messages:
Maya K: Quick q — I turned 50 on Aug 14 and our payroll switched from biweekly to monthly on Aug 1. My plan offers catch-up (limit $7,500) and pre-tax/Roth split. How do I set up catch-up so I can hit the full annual limit? Also can I move some catch-up to Roth? I have a rollover incoming. Thanks!

Ben (People Ops): Congrats Maya! Short answers: 1) You can start catch-up contributions the pay period after your 50th birthday (check plan doc); 2) Because we switched to monthly, you'll have fewer pay periods left — you can increase per-paycheck amount to reach the limit within the year; 3) Roth vs pre-tax catch-up depends on plan. We'll check vendor.

Jon T: For math, if you have 5 remaining paychecks and want $7,500 catch-up: `7500 / 5 = 1500` per paycheck. If you already contributed some catch-up earlier (rare), subtract that first.

Zara P: Our plan allows Roth catch-up? I thought we only had pre-tax for catch-up at Redwood plan... Ben?

Ben (People Ops): Current LanternBenefits setup supports Roth contributions but catch-up treatment follows plan elections. I'll confirm whether catch-up can be Roth vs pre-tax for our plan and update.

Payroll Bot: @Maya K please submit "Special Contribution Request" to payroll@redwood.com with: 1) desired annual catch-up amount, 2) split (pre-tax vs Roth), 3) effective pay date. Template: ```Name: Maya K
Employee ID: 12345
Annual catch-up target: 7500
Desired per-paycheck: 1500
Split: 50% pre-tax / 50% Roth
Effective: next monthly pay``` 

Maya K: If I do Roth catch-up, is tax withheld differently?

Ben (People Ops): Roth contributions are after-tax, so they reduce your take-home differently but don't change federal/SS withholding in form — payroll will calculate. Roth also affects tax reporting (W-2), no employer match on catch-up unless plan says so.

Jon T: Also note rollovers — you can roll previous 401k into plan, but incoming rollover doesn't increase annual deferral/catch-up limits. Rollover is separate; pre-tax vs Roth rollover rules apply.

Ben (People Ops): Action items: (1) Ben to confirm LanternBenefits catch-up Roth support (by EOD), (2) Maya to send payroll template, (3) Payroll to confirm per-paycheck setup and confirm if manual adjustments needed for split. I'll ping when vendor confirms.

Zara P: Thanks — tagging @payroll for visibility :eyes:

Payroll Bot: Acknowledged. Ticket #PB-4789 created.
